cards.text: DEMO — REFERENCE BREAKDOWN STORYBOARD

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Sample brief showing the BriefBoard format. Top lane = the reference creative, beat by beat: exact script, the frame from the reference, and what each beat is doing emotionally. Bottom lane = our adapted version for the editor to cut. This board was generated by Claude from a spec file — every real brief will look like this but with actual reference screenshots.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I found the bag everyone keeps asking me about
Handheld selfie, creator mid-walk, bag on shoulder

cards.title: EMOTION

Curiosity — hook. Open loop on 'the bag', starts mid-sentence

No intro, hard cut in

cards.title: OUR VERSION  ·  adapted beats for the editor

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Hard cuts only. Keep every clip under 3s except the reveal. Real hands, real motion on the demo beat.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No transitions, no zoom-punch effects, no music swell before 0:05. Never show the product in the first 2 seconds.

cards.title: SOUND
cards.text: VO is one continuous take laid over the cut — never chop the audio at clip boundaries.

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Six beats in 15s, same as the reference. Keep every clip under 3s and give the reveal beat at 0:05-0:08 the longest hold. Hard cuts only, and let the VO run as one take across the cuts.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No transitions or zoom-punch effects between beats. No music swell before 0:05. Don't chop the audio at clip boundaries and don't end on a static frame.
